item: Pinned Ollama for Linux x86_64 (the user's existing runner), same pin as q18
why: L2-2 and L2-3 need 'a pinned Ollama'. start_ollama.sh runs it at its own default address (OLLAMA_HOST unset), because L2-1 checks the answer's base_url against the runner's documented default.

candidates.source: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases (Linux amd64 archive of one tagged release)
candidates.size: about 1.5-2 GB archive (to confirm at pin time)
candidates.pin: same tag, asset URL and SHA-256 as q18's pins.env; setup_pinned_ollama.sh checks the hash

candidates.source: Docker Hub ollama/ollama:<version> (copy the binary and libraries into the dev image)
candidates.pin: pull by digest and record it

item: Frozen small model (Ollama tag) for the chat completion
why: L2-2 needs 'the frozen small model pulled'. Any chat model works (no tool calls); smaller is faster on CPU.

candidates.pin: pull the tag, record the digest from GET /api/tags in pins.env (FIXTURE_MODEL_DIGEST); bake the model store into the q20 base image

item: The user's Python environment: the official openai package, pinned, in a venv
why: The frozen script uses the official openai package (prompt). The package version decides how OpenAI() reads OPENAI_BASE_URL / OPENAI_API_KEY and what happens when no key is set, which L2-2 tests by running with OPENAI_API_KEY unset. While writing the fixtures, script/ask.py was run offline against a fake server with openai 3.40.0 (from the local uv cache): it works with base_url + api_key, and fails with 'api_key' in the error when no key is given.

candidates.size: about 1 MB wheel plus dependencies (httpx, pydantic, anyio, jiter, distro, sniffio, tqdm, typing-extensions): about 15 MB installed
candidates.pin: OPENAI_PKG_VERSION in pins.env; setup_user_env.sh installs `openai==<version>` and writes `pip freeze --all` to the state folder; commit that list with calibration.md

candidates.source: Ubuntu 24.04 apt package `python3-venv` (to create the venv)
candidates.pin: same apt snapshot id as the dev image

item: dev image: the clean Linux environment for every L2 check (base image, packages, user)
why: Settled by 9.3 B (念誠, 2026-10-31): every Linux question but q03 and q10 uses the dev image (ubuntu:24.04 + python3, git, ca-certificates, curl, strace), built and recorded in eval/results/l2-images.json. Fixture infrastructure this question names (the pinned Ollama and model) is installed by the grader from eval/fixtures/PINS.md, not baked into the image.
proposal: Packages: python3, python3-venv, ca-certificates, curl, sudo, strace. User `dev`. q20 base image = dev image + pinned Ollama + small model store + /opt/q20-venv + ~/ask.py.

item: strace in the dev image (the egress check)
why: Shared by every Linux question: listed once in eval/fixtures/_shared/needs.json (strace for _shared/egress.py).
